claim_boundary: Automated ranks compare two fixed signal representations; only recorded human listening can establish whether either acoustic neighborhood is useful.

log_mel.distance: mean absolute log10-mel difference per resolution, then mean

envelope.formula: 0.60 * normalized-curve MAE + 0.20 * attack seconds difference + 0.20 * decay seconds difference
envelope.decay: post-peak 90-to-40 percent; remaining duration when right-censored
envelope.units: mixed: dimensionless normalized amplitude and seconds

harmonic.formula: 0.70 * harmonic-profile MAE + 0.20 * noise-ratio difference + 0.10 * inharmonicity difference

descriptor.normalization: per target and family, divide by complete retrieval-library median raw distance
